LACUNA PULSE

Built-In Marketplace Scale

Deep supply. Diverse demand. Global reach.

  • Exclusive O&O Supply 2.4B+ installs across a flagship utility app and a broader portfolio of utility and gaming products. Available in 45 languages, reaching 200+ countries and regions. Particularly strong in SEA, South Asia, MEA, and Latin America.

  • Direct and Programmatic Demand10K+ direct advertiser campaigns spanning brand and performance budgets. Connectivity to 100+ premium DSPs across global markets.

LACUNA PRISM

Marketplace Intelligence Engine

Every impression, optimally matched.

  • Signal-Driven Traffic Routing Each DSP receives a feed tailored to how it buys, improving buyer ROI.

  • Dynamic Yield Optimization AI adjusts price floors in real time, improving seller RPM and eCPM.

  • Global-Scale Infrastructure High QPS capacity and low-latency architecture power reliable real-time bidding.

  • Low IVTIndependent verification from HUMAN, Pixalate, and DoubleVerify.
